Loading libraries
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("instacart")
library(plotly)
```

Loading data
```{r}
instacart_df = 
  instacart |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(100, 2, 3),
    y = x + rnorm(100)
  )

instacart_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point()
```
